rationale: The plan matches the reference on every substantive point: DESeq2 Wald on ~condition with control explicitly releveled, edgeR QL as a cross-check, a minimal filter set from the smallest group size, size factors and TMM inside the models, BH at 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage, and an explicit refusal to relax thresholds post hoc. QC is concrete (library sizes, VST PCA coloured by condition, correlation heatmap, PC1-vs-depth check) with a stated policy of flagging rather than dropping outliers and testing sensitivity by leave-one-out. The low-power caveat is stated directly (4 residual df, shrunk dispersions, need for orthogonal validation) and no attempt is made to compensate by lowering alpha. Enrichment was not asked for, but it is well specified (fgsea on the full Wald-ranked list, named MSigDB 2026.1 human collections, 15-500 size window, mapping rate reported) and correctly subordinated to the DE and confidence results. Versions, thresholds, tested and significant gene counts, and design caveats are all required outputs.
